jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer – Backend & AI
jobs.description:
### **Job Description**


**Job Role: Junior Software Engineer – Backend**


**Work Experience: 1–1\.5 Years**

  

  

**About**


 is India’s largest online pharmacy, specializing in providing super\-speciality medicines for critical conditions like cancer, kidney diseases, heart disorders, HIV/AIDS, transplants, hepatitis, and more.


We are a patient\-centric organization committed to improving access to medicines for individuals undergoing treatment for critical diseases. We understand the challenges patients face when they are unable to afford or access their prescribed medications, and we are dedicated to making sure that every patient receives the treatment they need.

  

  

Our team is passionate about improving healthcare through technology, and we are building products that solve real problems for patients, pharmacies, doctors, and our internal teams.

  

  

**Work You Will Do**


As a Junior Software Engineer – Backend, you will work with our engineering and product teams to design, build, and maintain backend services that power our customer\-facing products and internal systems.


You will primarily work with technologies such as Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch, and Kubernetes, depending on the project.

  

  

We are also actively exploring AI\-powered systems and workflows across the organization. We are looking for engineers who are comfortable with traditional backend engineering but are also curious about technologies such as LLMs, AI agents, MCP, OCR/document processing, RAG, AI APIs, AI infrastructure, vector databases, and other emerging AI technologies.


You do not need to have professional AI engineering experience. We care more about your ability to learn, experiment, build prototypes, and understand how these technologies can be applied to real problems.

  

  

**Responsibilities**


* Build, maintain, and improve backend services and APIs using Node.js and related technologies.
* Work with Product Managers, Frontend Engineers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into reliable technical solutions.
* Work with databases and infrastructure components such as MongoDB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch/Solr, and Kubernetes as required by the application.
* Write clean, maintainable, testable code and follow established engineering practices.
* Debug production and development issues systematically and contribute to improving system reliability and performance.
* Participate in code reviews and learn from feedback while contributing constructive feedback to other engineers.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively for research, prototyping, debugging, documentation, and implementation while maintaining ownership and understanding of the resulting code.
* Contribute to AI\-related projects and experiments, which may involve LLMs, AI agents, MCP, OCR, document processing, RAG, AI APIs, vector databases, AI infrastructure, or other emerging technologies.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts to evaluate new technologies and determine whether they can solve practical business problems.
* Work across the technology stack when required and understand how backend services interact with frontend applications, databases, third\-party systems, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of assigned features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced startup environment where requirements can evolve and engineers are expected to solve problems rather than simply execute predefined instructions.
  

  

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–1\.5 years of professional software development experience, with strong internship or project experience considered for exceptional candidates.
* Good working knowledge of Node.js and backend development fundamentals.
* Familiarity with databases, preferably MongoDB, and a basic understanding of concepts such as indexing, queries, data modelling, and performance.
* Understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, asynchronous programming, and common backend architecture patterns.
* Exposure to technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch/Solr, Docker, or Kubernetes is a strong plus, but deep expertise in every technology is not expected at this experience level.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools effectively while still understanding, reviewing, debugging, and taking ownership of the code produced.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI technologies is strongly preferred. This could include personal projects, internships, hackathons, coursework, experimentation, or professional work involving LLMs, AI APIs, RAG, agents, MCP, OCR, document processing, vector databases, AI infrastructure, or similar technologies.
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or meaningful personal project demonstrating technical curiosity and independent problem\-solving is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is a plus, but not mandatory.
  

  

**What We Are Looking For**


We are looking for someone who can combine solid software engineering fundamentals with curiosity about AI.

  

  

AI tools are becoming increasingly capable of writing code, but we believe strong engineers will remain valuable because they can understand problems, reason about systems, make trade\-offs, and take responsibility for outcomes.

  

  

You should be comfortable using AI tools to:


* Explore unfamiliar technologies.
* Understand documentation and APIs.
* Prototype ideas.
* Generate or improve code.
* Debug issues.
* Analyse logs and errors.
* Automate repetitive engineering work.
  

  

But you should also be able to independently evaluate what those tools produce.


We want engineers who ask:

  

  

**"Why is this the right solution?"**

jobs.description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.


  
**Your mission**
----------------


**About the Organisation \& Role:**


You will be part of the Consumer Intelligence \& Engagement organisation responsible for delivering the intelligence and engagement capabilities that enable more relevant and personalised consumer experiences across digital channels. The organisation plays a key role in how consumers discover products, engage with content, and elevate experiences through membership \& loyalty. Through capabilities such as personalisation, recommendations, consumer intelligence, experimentation, and AI\-driven decisioning, the organisation helps deliver more contextual, data\-driven interactions across the consumer journey.


As a Software Engineer, you will build the AI and backend services that power personalisation and recommendation capabilities. You will be responsible for technical design, build and validation. Working closely with the Lead Engineer and Engineering Manager, you will deliver low latency services that support real\-time consumer experiences.

  

**What you will do:**


* Design and build scalable, low latency APIs, event\-driven services, and integration layers that support real\-time and batch recommendation use cases.
* Build model\-serving and inference integration layers that support real\-time and batch recommendation patterns.
* Implement reliable, scalable, and low\-latency services with strong focus on resiliency, observability, and performance.
* Work with caching, event\-driven processing and distributed systems patterns to support high\-volume consumer use cases.
* Ensure solutions are secure, observable, reliable, and resilient through strong engineering practices.
* Optimise performance, scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency through automation and proactive improvements.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering practices and tools to improve engineering productivity, code quality, and delivery effectiveness.
**Your talent**
---------------


* 4\+ years of experience designing and building large scale distributed backend systems on cloud\-native platforms.
* Hands\-on experience building and operating recommendation and personalisation capabilities.
* Expertise in backend engineering, API design, microservices, event\-driven architectures, and scalable integration patterns using Java, Spring Boot and related frameworks.
* Experience integrating and operationalising LLM APIs and AI services within production applications.
* Experience working with feature stores, vector databases, embedding based retrieval and modern ML architectures will be a strong advantage.
* Experience with Redis or equivalent caching systems.
* Experience with observability, reliability engineering and performance optimisation.

* Experience using coding agents, LLMs or AI\-assisted engineering tools to improve software delivery and developer productivity.
* Experience in eCommerce, retail, or consumer digital products is strongly preferred.
**Our principles**
------------------


PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.


PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

jobs.title: Generative AI Data Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!


Our people make all the difference in our success.


\-


**About us:**


Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast\-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.


**What do we offer:**


USCC EDO team manages the implementation of best\-in\-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:


* **Data Governance**: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
* **Meta Data Management**: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
* **Data Ownership**: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
* **Issue Management**: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
* **Audit Support**: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
* **Data Certification**: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

**Expertise Required:**


Data/Information Mgt Int Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI\-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision\-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands\-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM\-based applications and AI agents.


**Metadata Management and Data Governance**


* **Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary:** Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
* **Data Lineage Mapping:** Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

**Data Profiling and Analysis**


* **Profiling Execution:** Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
* **Data Assessment:** Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

**Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring**


* **Rule Definition:** Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).
* **Rule Authoring/Implementation:** Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and preventative/detective controls using SQL, Python, or specialized DQ tools.
* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception\-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**


* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**


* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long\-term solutions.
   

*(Preferred)* –

**Design and Develop AI powered solution across data Quality lifecycle utilizing Agentic AI frameworks**


**Technical Skills**


* Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra
* Experience with prompt engineering
* Experience building LLM\-based applications, AI agents, or autonomous workflows
* Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
* Exposure to creating multi\-agent orchestration
* Exposure to BI tools and technologies – example: Tableau
* Automation and process re\-engineering / optimization skills

**Domain Skills**


Good understanding of


* Banking domain (Cards, Deposit, Loans, Wealth management, \& Insurance etc.)
* Audit Framework
* Data quality framework
* Risk \& control Metrics

*(Preferred)* \- Knowledge of Finance Regulations, Understanding of Audit Process


**Soft Skills**


* Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the senior man

jobs.title: Web Solutions Engineer, Technology and Insights Partnership Systems, Youtube India
jobs.description:
### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 4 years of experience in full\-stack or back\-end software development and system design.
* Experience with distributed data processing (e.g., BigQuery, Spark), event streaming (e.g., Kafka), and scalable communication protocols (e.g., gRPC, Protocol Buffers).
* Experience working with database technologies (e.g. SQL, NoSQL).

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* 4 years of experience designing and optimizing databases.
* Experience working with systems for collaborative code reviews, version control, continuous integration, and automated testing.
* Ability to manage ambiguous requirements and influence both technical and non\-technical stakeholders (Product Managers, UX Designers, Business Leaders).
* Strong systems fundamentals with prior experience working with, or an eagerness to master, agentic AI frameworks and LLM tooling (e.g., LLMs, Agentic harnesses, Vector Embeddings, and RAG).

**About the job**
-----------------


The Content Partnerships Systems team within Technology and Insights (T\&I) is the technical engine that powers YouTube's relationships with its global creators and partners. We develop the critical infrastructure and tooling used by Strategic Partner Managers to drive channel growth, manage complex portfolios, and optimize product activations. Our systems manage the end\-to\-end partner lifecycle—from propensity modeling and incentive tracking to complex CRM workflows—ensuring our business teams can deliver tailored, data\-driven support to the creator ecosystem.


As this ecosystem scales, our team is evolving. Our mission is anchored in our core pillars: AI Integration, Scalability, and Sustainability.  

  

Google's Web Solutions Engineers (WSE) develop the software\-based solutions for complex business problems. We are looking for someone who is interested in automation, building scalable solutions, and demonstrating deep software engineering best practices.  

  

As an Web Solutions Engineer on the YouTube Technology and Insights team, you will focus primarily on backend service architecture, high\-throughput data pipelines, and API integrations that connect with client web applications and partner portals.  

  

You understand the importance of code quality and test coverage. You have a strong bias towards action and a passion for providing smart, scalable solutions. Excellent communication skills are a must, as you will interact frequently and closely with our stakeholders from around the world and across different teams (Product, UX, Data Engineering and TPgM).
  

  

You will have the opportunity to learn and grow inside YouTube. We need our engineers to be versatile and passionate to address new problems as we continue to push technology forward for the benefit of our users.

  

At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting\-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Design, build, and maintain backend service layers and APIs which integrate seamlessly with web\-based client applications to deliver automated workflows and actionable insights to end\-users.
* Design, build, and deploy AI\-powered solutions (Single and Multi\-Agent systems with Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG); versioned prompt libraries; skills; evals) using Google’s Agent Development Kit.
* Deliver high\-quality code and tests, ensuring the reliability, security, and accuracy of deployed solutions, including testing and evaluation frameworks for deterministic and model\-based outputs.
* Write and review technical design documents for scalable systems. Develop project plans and deliver engineering projects on time and within budget with minimal guidance.
* Develop new approaches to solving business problems at scale, including opportunities to use rule\-based and AI\-based automations to eliminate operational friction and technical debt. Collaborate across time zones and act as a trusted technical representative on cross\-functional projects.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

We’re looking for a **Forward Deployment Engineer** to work at the intersection of engineering, product and the business.



As a Forward Deployment Engineer, you will take technology from **prototype to production** by working directly with internal stakeholders to understand real\-world problems, rapidly build and integrate solutions, and deploy them into production environments.



This is a highly hands\-on engineering role for someone who enjoys operating close to the customer, moving quickly from ambiguity to working software, and taking ownership beyond writing code.



You will partner with product managers, engineers, architects, data specialists and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, develop solutions, validate them in real environments and scale successful implementations across NatWest.


**What you’ll do**


* Work directly with business and product teams to understand complex problems and translate them into technical solutions.
* Rapidly prototype, build and deploy production\-quality applications and integrations.
* Own solutions end\-to\-end \- from discovery and technical design through development, deployment, adoption and continuous improvement.
* Embed with teams and operate close to the problem rather than working purely as a central engineering function.
* Integrate applications with existing platforms, APIs, data sources and enterprise systems.
* Develop reusable components, services and patterns that can be scaled across teams.
* Work across the full engineering lifecycle, including coding, testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and production support.
* Diagnose technical issues in live environments and work collaboratively to resolve them.
* Partner with architecture, security, platform and infrastructure teams to ensure solutions meet enterprise standards.
* Use data, experimentation and user feedback to iterate rapidly and demonstrate measurable impact.
* Help identify where emerging technologies, including AI and GenAI, can solve meaningful business problems.
* Document solutions and share learnings so successful approaches can be adopted more broadly.
* Influence engineering practices and contribute to a strong engineering culture.


**What we’re looking for**


**Engineering**


* Strong software engineering fundamentals with experience building production applications.
* Strong proficiency in at least one modern programming language such as **Python, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go or C\#**.
* **Strong proficiency in AI/ML, GenAI, LLM applications, AI agents and Data engineering or analytics**
* Experience designing and consuming **REST APIs, microservices and distributed systems**.
* Experience with **cloud technologies**, preferably GCP, AWS or Azure.
* Strong understanding of databases, data structures and system integration.
* Experience with **Git, CI/CD, automated testing and modern software development practices**.
* Understanding of observability, logging, monitoring and production troubleshooting.
* Experience working with containers and/or Kubernetes.


**Forward deployment mindset**


* Comfortable working with ambiguity and turning loosely defined problems into working solutions.
* Able to move quickly between **discovery, prototyping and production engineering**.
* Strong customer and stakeholder orientation.
* Comfortable working directly with senior business and technical stakeholders.
* Able to explain complex technical concepts to non\-technical audiences.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging capability.
* Pragmatic: knows when to build quickly, when to engineer for scale and when to reuse an existing capability.
* Takes ownership for outcomes rather than only technical deliverables.


**Advantageous experience**



Experience in one or more of the following would be valuable:


* Cloud\-native application development
* API and platform integration
* DevOps / SRE
* Financial services or other highly regulated environments
* Enterprise technology transformation
* Rapid prototyping / innovation engineering


**What success looks like**



In this role, success isn’t simply measured by the amount of code you write.



You will be successful when you can:


**Understand Build Deploy Adopt Scale**


* Turn a business problem into a viable technical solution.
* Get a working solution into the hands of users quickly.
* Build trust with stakeholders through technical expertise and delivery.
* Take solutions into production safely and sustainably.
* Demonstrate measurable business or customer impact.
* Turn successful experiments into reusable engineering capabilities.


**Why this role is different**



The Forward Deployment Engineer operates **where the problem is**, not just where the engineering team sits.



You will have the opportunity to combine the depth of a software engineer with the curiosity of a product thinker and the stakeholder skills of a solutions engineer.



You’ll work on problems where the solution isn’t always known upfront \- and you’ll be expected to discover, build and deploy the answer.

You do not need to have professional AI engineering experience. We care more about your ability to learn, experiment, build prototypes, and understand how these technologies can be applied to real problems.

* Write clean, maintainable, testable code and follow established engineering practices.
* Debug production and development issues systematically and contribute to improving system reliability and performance.
* Participate in code reviews and learn from feedback while contributing constructive feedback to other engineers.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools effectively for research, prototyping, debugging, documentation, and implementation while maintaining ownership and understanding of the resulting code.
* Contribute to AI\-related projects and experiments, which may involve LLMs, AI agents, MCP, OCR, document processing, RAG, AI APIs, vector databases, AI infrastructure, or other emerging technologies.
* Build prototypes and proof\-of\-concepts to evaluate new technologies and determine whether they can solve practical business problems.
* Work across the technology stack when required and understand how backend services interact with frontend applications, databases, third\-party systems, and infrastructure.
* Take ownership of assigned features from understanding the problem through implementation, testing, deployment, and iteration.
* Work effectively in a fast\-paced startup environment where requirements can evolve and engineers are expected to solve problems rather than simply execute predefined instructions.
  

  

**Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 1–1\.5 years of professional software development experience, with strong internship or project experience considered for exceptional candidates.
* Good working knowledge of Node.js and backend development fundamentals.
* Familiarity with databases, preferably MongoDB, and a basic understanding of concepts such as indexing, queries, data modelling, and performance.
* Understanding of APIs, HTTP, authentication, asynchronous programming, and common backend architecture patterns.
* Exposure to technologies such as Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch/Solr, Docker, or Kubernetes is a strong plus, but deep expertise in every technology is not expected at this experience level.
* Strong understanding of programming fundamentals, data structures, algorithms, and problem\-solving.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI\-assisted development tools effectively while still understanding, reviewing, debugging, and taking ownership of the code produced.
* Hands\-on exposure to AI technologies is strongly preferred. This could include personal projects, internships, hackathons, coursework, experimentation, or professional work involving LLMs, AI APIs, RAG, agents, MCP, OCR, document processing, vector databases, AI infrastructure, or similar technologies.
* A GitHub profile, portfolio, or meaningful personal project demonstrating technical curiosity and independent problem\-solving is a strong plus.
* Startup experience is a plus, but not mandatory.
  

  

**What We Are Looking For**


We are looking for someone who can combine solid software engineering fundamentals with curiosity about AI.

  

  

AI tools are becoming increasingly capable of writing code, but we believe strong engineers will remain valuable because they can understand problems, reason about systems, make trade\-offs, and take responsibility for outcomes.

**Your mission**
----------------

new_jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


We value our talented employees, and whenever possible strive to help one of our associates grow professionally before recruiting new talent to our open positions. If you think the open position you see is right for you, we encourage you to apply!


Our people make all the difference in our success.


\-


**About us:**


Analytics Information management (AIM) is a global community that is driving data driven transformation across Citi in multiple functions with the objective to create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We are a fast\-growing organization working with Citi businesses and functions across the world.


**What do we offer:**


USCC EDO team manages the implementation of best\-in\-class data quality measurement programs across globe in retail consumer bank. The critical areas we support:


* **Data Governance**: Standardization of data definitions and ensuring consistency in usage as per definitions across systems/products/regions.
* **Meta Data Management**: Leveraging data lineage, data discovery initiatives and creation of enterprise level meta data for all retail consumer products
* **Data Ownership**: Identifying trusted data sources, data owners and consumers across process and products
* **Issue Management**: Identifying defects and investigating root causes for different issues. Following up with stakeholders and creation of plan for resolution as per SLA
* **Audit Support**: Identifying cases on control gaps, policy breaches and providing data evidence for audit completion
* **Data Certification**: Developing procedures on data certification and certifying as per fit for purpose criteria

**Expertise Required:**


Data/Information Mgt Int Analyst is responsible for ensuring the organization’s data is accurate, complete, consistent, and reliable to support strategic planning and operational efficiency. This role involves profiling data to identify flaws, authoring data quality rules to prevent issues, monitoring data pipelines, managing metadata and remediate data concerns. This person will also be responsible to design, develop, and deploy scalable AI\-powered solutions that enhance enterprise workflows and decision\-making. The ideal candidate will combine strong software engineering skills with hands\-on experience in machine learning and generative AI systems, including LLM\-based applications and AI agents.


**Metadata Management and Data Governance**


* **Maintain Data Catalog/Dictionary:** Document and maintain business, technical, and operational metadata, including data lineage, definitions, and data standards.
* **Data Lineage Mapping:** Utilize metadata to map data lineage, understanding how data flows from source systems to downstream reporting to identify potential impact areas.
* **Policy Compliance:** Ensure all data assets adhere to defined data governance policies and data privacy regulations.

**Data Profiling and Analysis**


* **Profiling Execution:** Perform deep profiling of large datasets to understand data structure, patterns, and content, identifying hidden anomalies or missing information.
* **Root Cause Analysis (RCA):** Investigate data quality issues to determine the root cause, distinguishing between upstream processing errors and data entry errors.
* **Data Assessment:** Evaluate critical data elements (CDEs) for accuracy and completeness.

**Data Quality Rule Creation and Authoring**


* **Rule Definition:** Collaborate with business stakeholders to define and validate business rules for data validation (e.g., completeness, accuracy, consistency, validity).
* **Rule Authoring/Implementation:** Develop and implement data quality rules, checks, and preventative/detective controls using SQL, Python, or specialized DQ tools.
* **Validation Logic:** Document validation logic and exception\-handling procedures for critical datasets.

**Data Monitoring and Reporting**


* **Continuous Monitoring:** Actively monitor data pipelines, ETL processes, and dashboards to proactively identify DQ issues and operational anomalies.
* **DQ Dashboards/Scorecards:** Develop and maintain data quality metrics and scorecards to report on data accuracy trends to leadership.
* **Alerting:** Set up automated alerts for breach of data quality thresholds.

**Data Concern Remediations**


* **Issue Resolution:** Identify, document, and triage data quality issues through a tracking system.
* **Remediation Action Plans:** Develop and execute remediation plans, including data cleansing efforts and automated corrections.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with data stewards, IT, and developers to resolve data issues and implement long\-term solutions.
   

*(Preferred)* –

**Design and Develop AI powered solution across data Quality lifecycle utilizing Agentic AI frameworks**


**Technical Skills**


* Proficient in Python, SAS, SQL, Teradata, Collibra
* Experience with prompt engineering
* Experience building LLM\-based applications, AI agents, or autonomous workflows
* Exposure to LangChain / LangGraph frameworks
* Exposure to creating multi\-agent orchestration
* Exposure to BI tools and technologies – example: Tableau
* Automation and process re\-engineering / optimization skills

**Domain Skills**


Good understanding of


* Banking domain (Cards, Deposit, Loans, Wealth management, \& Insurance etc.)
* Audit Framework
* Data quality framework
* Risk \& control Metrics

*(Preferred)* \- Knowledge of Finance Regulations, Understanding of Audit Process


**Soft Skills**


* Ability to identify, clearly articulate and solve complex business problems and present them to the senior man
